ingredients.notes: All ingredients use edible gram weights. Allergen disclosures and the new illustration were checked against the ingredient list.

method.notes: Adapted from Julia Turshen's yogurt and olive oil cake, with roughly half the wet ingredients for a small round tin and peeled orange purée in place of the juice. The cake is baked until fully set with no raw batter on a skewer. Six slices, with resting and cooling included in total time.

food_safety.notes: The whole cake is baked until the centre is set and the tester comes out without raw batter.

servings_and_time.notes: 6 portions with 90 minutes including the specified cooking and resting or cooling periods.
